name: CIDR Calculator
description: Calculate IPv4 and IPv6 network details and plan subnets
help: Enter an IPv4 or IPv6 address and prefix, for example 192.168.1.10/24 or 2001:db8::1/64.
Subnet planning divides the network into equal-sized subnets and displays results in pages.
IPv4 /31 uses both addresses for point-to-point links; /32 represents one host. IPv6 displays the full address range.

input.label: IP CIDR
input.hint: Enter an IPv4 or IPv6 address and prefix, such as 192.168.1.10/24 or 2001:db8::1/64

empty: Enter a CIDR to calculate network details

result.title: Network details
result.hostHint: /31 counts both addresses for point-to-point links; /32 represents a single host.
result.ipv6Hint: IPv6 has no broadcast address. The range and count include all addresses; actual assignability depends on network configuration.

plan.title: Subnet planning
plan.hint: Divide {{cidr}} into equal subnets. Choose a prefix from /{{prefix}} to /{{max}}.

errors.cidr.invalid: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR, such as 192.168.1.10/24 or 2001:db8::1/64.
errors.cidr.invalid_prefix: The target prefix must be at least the original prefix and no greater than the address family maximum.
errors.cidr.invalid_page: The subnet page is out of range.
